messages:
zoe-sec: Security advisory: we detected a signing key used for model artifacts (model-signer-prod) in a rotated backup snapshot in a vendor S3 bucket. Treat as compromised until proven otherwise. Immediate actions below.

alfie-build: Confirmed. Which key material exactly? private key PEM for signer?

zoe-sec: Yes, private PEM and associated passphrase were present in snapshot metadata. Vendor says snapshot came from an automated backup we enabled in 2023. Audit link: https://internal.redwood/sec/1755555555.

maya-mlops: Quick impact scope: any model bundles published with that signer in the last 90 days need re-signing + republishing. Also CI that verifies signatures must be updated to trust the new key.

carlos-oncall: Actions I'm taking now: 1) block the signer key in the artifact verification allowlist; 2) revoke key in KMS and rotate to a new keypair; 3) open incident ticket SEC-1755555555.

audit-bot: Automated check: signer usage (90d): 12 published model bundles, 3 private customer deploys referencing signer id, 4 CI jobs performing signature verify. Full list: https://internal.redwood/sec/1755555555/artifact-list.

zoe-sec: Required owner actions (deadline 48hrs):
- Rotate signing key and publish new public key to allowlist.
- Rebuild and re-sign any model bundles listed. Re-publish with new signature.
- Update verification components (CI runners, private deploys) to trust new key ID.
- If you cannot re-sign quickly, disable automated deploys that validate signatures to avoid trusting compromised artifacts.

alfie-build: For CI: we'll add a temporary gate to block any artifact signed with old key ID. Pushing a patch to infra-ci now.

maya-mlops: We'll coordinate re-signing for model-bundles and model-registry owners. Can you share a script to bulk-verify and re-sign?

zoe-sec: Use this helper: `scripts/signer/reoptimize-and-resign.sh --key new-key-id --artifact-list artifacts.txt` We'll drop artifacts.txt into the report page.

carlos-oncall: Note for private deploy owners: if your customers pull signed model artifacts, coordinate with account-ops. We will provide a signed-commit manifest to verify revocation and re-issuance.

zoe-sec: Legal/privacy: no customer data in snapshots per initial scan, but we are still running deeper checks. If any customer-owned models are affected we'll notify account-ops.

audit-bot: Reminder: submit remediation ticket with label `artifact-signing-rotation`. Auto-template available at https://issues.redwood/security/templates/artifact-rotation.

alfie-build: PR up: infra-ci blocks old-signatures and alerts owners. Link: https://scm.internal.redwood/p/infra-ci/+/1234.

maya-mlops: Re-sign pipeline started for 8 of 12 bundles. ETA for all: 24h. We'll post artifacts replaced list in the incident ticket.

zoe-sec: After re-sign/republish, update the allowlist and mark the old key revoked. We'll run a follow-up verification sweep at 72h. If you need an exception, open SEC-1755555555/exempt with justification.

carlos-oncall: Adding postmortem owner: maya-mlops. Please capture root cause (why backup had key), remediation steps, and checklist to prevent vendor snapshot of secrets.

zoe-sec: Short-term mitigation: rotate any other keys that were co-located in that snapshot. Long-term: vendor backup exclusion list + automated secrets redaction before vendor-side snapshots.

maya-mlops: Acknowledged. Will include automated redaction script in model-registry deployment by EOD.

zoe-sec: Thanks. This is high priority. I'll maintain the incident thread and update external notification guidance if needed. :lock:

alfie-build: Noted. Posting progress updates in the incident ticket.

maya-mlops: Will tag owners of the 3 private deploys and coordinate account-ops outreach.

audit-bot: Follow-up scan scheduled at 72h.
